description: UIM Datasphere — spaces, connections, remote tables, views, data flows, schedules, data access controls and catalog

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Read
scopes.description: Read spaces, models, schedules, runs and the catalog; check row access

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Integrate
scopes.description: Validate connections; replicate, run data flows, persist views; deploy; run and pause schedules

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Model
scopes.description: Maintain remote tables, views, data flows, data access controls and the catalog

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manage
scopes.description: Maintain spaces, members, connections, tasks and task chains; purge runs

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Manage the user accounts of the built-in login (not used with XSUAA)

role-templates.name: Integrator
role-templates.description: Run and monitor the data integration

role-templates.name: Modeler
role-templates.description: Build models and govern them; run them

role-templates.name: SpaceAdministrator
role-templates.description: Manage spaces, connections and schedules; model; run
